name: 4C-TFM
summary: 4C-TFM, also known as TFM-Ariadne or 4C-DOTFM, as well as 4-trifluoromethyl-2,5-dimethoxy-α-ethylphenethylamine, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the phenethylamine, phenylisobutylamine, and 4C families related to Ariadne (4C-D).

pharmacology.text: 4C-TFM, also known as TFM-Ariadne or 4C-DOTFM, as well as 4-trifluoromethyl-2,5-dimethoxy-α-ethylphenethylamine, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the phenethylamine, phenylisobutylamine, and 4C families related to Ariadne (4C-D). The drug is a potent agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist
